g.text: Short press (BUTTON_SINGLE_CLICK of logiBUS_IE): off -> on with the stored brightness (first time START), on -> off; ramp time SOFT – Event

Long press begins (BUTTON_LONG_PRESS_START): dim stepless towards LEVEL_MAX or LEVEL_MIN. Every long press changes the direction, the first one after switching on dims down; at the end it dims the other way. From off: on and dim up – Event
Long press ends (BUTTON_LONG_PRESS_UP): stop dimming, the brightness stays and is stored – Event
Switch on directly with the stored brightness (nothing happens if already on) – Event
Switch off directly, e.g. central off (nothing happens if already off) – Event
Event – Confirmation of TOGGLE, DIM_START, DIM_STOP, SWITCH_ON, SWITCH_OFF
Event – Ramp finished: LEVEL_MIN or LEVEL_MAX reached while dimming, or switching on/off finished. Not after DIM_STOP

PWM frequency in Hz, read at INIT. Outputs with the same frequency share an LEDC timer (4 timers, LED blinking uses one). Power stage limits, not checked: APIXON 15 PWR Q1 (BTH50030) max. 100 Hz; BTS7030/BTT6030/BTH6070 for valves 100..200 Hz; Trainer20 without power stage – UDINT
Time for the whole range LEVEL_MIN..LEVEL_MAX while dimming; a shorter rest takes proportionally less time, so the speed is always the same – TIME
Lowest brightness for dimming in % (0..100) – REAL
Highest brightness for dimming in % (0..100) – REAL
Brightness in % for the first switching on, before anything is stored – REAL
Ramp time for switching on and off (TOGGLE, SWITCH_ON, SWITCH_OFF). T#0ms = jump – TIME
BOOL – TRUE = on, FALSE as soon as switching off begins
REAL – Brightness in %: on CNF the target of switching on/off or the stopped brightness, on RAMPO the brightness reached
